library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(scales)

heatmap_virus_top_mean <- read.table(
  "D:/Airport/Plot_MEAN_RPKMF_heatmap.txt",
  header      = TRUE,
  sep         = "\t",
  check.names = FALSE
)



colnames(heatmap_virus_top_mean) <- c("Name", "Domestic", "International")

heat_long <- heatmap_virus_top_mean %>%
  pivot_longer(cols      = c(Domestic, International),
               names_to  = "Airport",
               values_to = "RPKMF") %>%
  mutate(
    log_val = ifelse(is.na(RPKMF), NA, log10(RPKMF + 1)),
    Airport = factor(Airport, levels = c("Domestic", "International"))
  )

name_order <- heatmap_virus_top_mean %>%
  mutate(mean_val = rowMeans(cbind(Domestic, International), na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  arrange(mean_val) %>%
  pull(Name)

heat_long <- heat_long %>%
  mutate(Name = factor(Name, levels = name_order))

heatp2 <- ggplot(heat_long, aes(x = Airport, y = Name, fill = log_val)) +
 
  geom_tile(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.3,
            width = 0.8, height = 0.8) +
 
  geom_tile(data = heat_long %>% filter(is.na(log_val)),
            fill = "#F0F0F0", color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.3,
            width = 0.8, height = 0.8) +
 
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = c("#FFFFFF", "#C8EDE8", "#41B8A0", "#6B4FA0", "#2D1B5E"),
    values   = scales::rescale(c(0, 0.15, 0.4, 0.7, 1)),
    na.value = "#F0F0F0",
    name     = "log10(RPKMF + 1)",
    limits   = c(0, NA),
    guide    = guide_colorbar(
      barwidth       = 0.6,
      barheight      = 10,
      ticks          = TRUE,
      direction      = "vertical",
      title.position = "top",
      title.hjust    = 0.5,
      frame.colour   = "grey40"
    )
  ) +
 
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1.5, color = "grey50",
             linewidth = 0.4, linetype = "dashed") +
 
  scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0.4, 0.4)) +
  scale_y_discrete(expand = c(0.01, 0.01)) +
 
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
 
  theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, colour = "black",
                               face = "bold", angle = 45,
                               hjust = 1, vjust = 1,
                               margin = margin(t = 6)),
    axis.text.y      = element_text(size = 7.5, colour = "black",
                                    face = "italic", hjust = 1),
    axis.ticks       = element_blank(),
    panel.grid       = element_blank(),
    panel.border     = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    legend.position  = "left",
    legend.title     = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    legend.text      = element_text(size = 9),
    plot.margin      = margin(0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5, "cm"),
    plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
  )

heatp2
